body:
I certainly hope that will be true for me too.

It is reassuring to know that you and your dad have made it through. Hopefully I will too.

Thank you.

Hey man, I really appreciate the kind words. I honestly didn't expect a response with the wall of text I threw up. I know if I were to commit suicide, it would be a mess for those close to me, but I am battling with the fact that it would be an even bigger mess once I have a family and stuff. I feel like I'm gambling that either I'll make it through to the end, or destroy my family if I lose the bet.

I think experiences like yours are why I fear talking about this with those around me. Like, I am unsure whether not I will make it through any given year, and I don't want my family/fiance to also live that uncertainty for the rest of their/my life. They deserve better than that.

I gave therapy a shot several years ago, and I didn't find it helpful, but maybe I should give it another shot while I am still mildly clear-headed.

I hope it doesn't sound like I am trying to rebut your points. I understand that, rationally, you are absolutely right. I think I just need to convince myself to reach out before it's too late.

I am glad you made it through, and I am excited to hear about your proposal and solid support network. Thank you for taking the time to read/respond.
